title: Utahime: The Songstress
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In a kingdom kept at peace by village singers, a power passed from mother to daughter, the king confines the singers in towers to sing constantly (AniList). Kain tries to protect his sister Maria from that fate, and after her death sings in her place as the Song Princess, a secret known only to the village head (AniList; MangaUpdates). A runaway woman pursued by the Royal Guard then seeks him out. One volume, with the one-shot 'Darika'; a shoujo tragedy.
life_message: Love for family can drive a person to defy an unjust destiny, though at great cost (to verify).
